en.t: The fierce wind did not let up all night.

units.source_text: 众侍女悄悄地互相告道：“今晚如果源氏公子不来，我们这里多么害怕！

en.t: The maids whispered to one another, "If Lord Genji does not come tonight, how frightened we will be here!

units.source_text: 要是姑娘年纪和公子相称，多么好呢！”

en.t: If only the young lady were an age to match him, how wonderful that would be!"

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母替姑娘担心，紧紧地坐在她身旁。

en.t: Shonagon, her nurse, was anxious for the girl and sat close beside her.
After a while, the wind gradually died down.

units.source_text: 源氏公子要在天没有亮之前回去，此时他心中觉得仿佛是和情人幽会之后一般。

en.t: Lord Genji had to return before dawn, and just then he felt as though he were leaving after a secret meeting with a lover.

units.source_text: 便对乳母说：“我看了姑娘的样子，觉得非常可怜。

en.t: He said to the nurse, "When I saw the young lady, I felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 尤其是现在，我觉得片刻也舍不得她了。

en.t: Especially now, I feel I cannot bear to part from her even for a moment.

units.source_text: 我想让她迁居到我二条院的邸内来，好朝夜看到她。

en.t: I want to have her move into my residence at Nijo so that I can see her morning and night.

units.source_text: 这种地方怎么可以常住呢？

en.t: How can anyone go on living in a place like this?
You are all far too bold!"

units.source_text: 乳母答道：“兵部卿大人也说要来迎接她去。

en.t: The nurse replied, "His Lordship the Prince of War has also said that he will come to take her away.

units.source_text: 且过了老太太断七[\[27\]](#part1334.html#m27)之后再说吧。”

en.t: Let us at least wait until after the old lady's forty-ninth-day rites[\[27\]](#part1334.html#m27), and then discuss it."

units.source_text: 公子说：“兵部卿虽然是她父亲，可是一向分居，全同他人一样生疏吧。

en.t: The prince said, "Although the Prince of War is her father, he has always lived apart from her and must be as distant as a stranger.

units.source_text: 我今后一定做她的保护人。

en.t: From now on I will certainly be her guardian.

units.source_text: 我对她的爱，比她父亲真心得多呢。”

en.t: My love for her is far more sincere than her father's."

units.source_text: 他说过之后，摸摸紫儿的头发，起身告辞，还是屡次回头，依依不忍遽去。

en.t: After saying this, he stroked Murasaki's hair, rose to take his leave, and still turned back again and again, lingering with reluctance to go.
